summary: Accel Atoms FAQ explicitly describes rolling AI-cohort applications and participation for Indian and Indian-origin founders. However, the live application URL currently returns an upgrade notice rather than a usable form. Current application access needs confirmation.

sources.title: Accel Atoms FAQ
sources.supports: Rolling AI applications, Indian-origin eligibility, investment terms and solo-founder eligibility for Atoms X.

sources.title: Accel Atoms application page
sources.supports: Live page displays an application-experience upgrade notice dated July 11 without a year; searchable cached application content differs.

notes: AI and Atoms X are distinct cohorts with different investment ceilings. Do not promise a fixed equity percentage or an exact next cohort date. The FAQ and live application endpoint are inconsistent.
